generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The use of `queryPosition` in the new condition (and the subsequent call to `getQuery`) will trigger an `IndexOutOfBoundsException` on the first iteration of the loop, as the field is initialized to `-1` and only incremented at the end of the loop body. The initialization should be changed to `0`, or the variable should be incremented before its first use in `nextQuery`.
